Update Contents (version 3.9.0)

Thank you for playing Pokémon Sleep!

This update includes the following improvements.
You will need to update to the latest version through your app store.

Update Contents

New Features

Preparation for new events

Halloween 2026 — Double Candy Research

Meal Prep Week Vol. 1

Bountiful Banquet Week Vol. 1

Please see the event’s upcoming News announcement for more details.

Preparation for New Ingredients and Recipes

The following features will be added on Nov. 15, 2026, at 7:00 p.m. .

• Ingredient: Snackable Nuts

• 3 recipes that use Snackable Nuts

Balance Adjustments

Means of Encountering Mythical Pokémon Being Reconsidered

Regarding the appearance of Mythical Pokémon on New Moon Day, from now on, you will be able to encounter Mythical Pokémon specific to each event.

From Good Sleep Day #40

• Mew

From New Moon Day #19

• Darkrai

Note: Mew will no longer appear

Please see the event news for more details.

Adjustments to certain helper Pokémon’s helping stats

Gengar

• Ingredient finding chance increased

Other

New Sleep Style Dex Goal to Be Added

The new Sleep Style Dex Goal (570 Styles) will be added on Nov. 8, 2026, at 7:00 p.m. .

Note: Achieving this goal will allow you to expand the capacity of your cooking pot

Improvements to the Recipe List Screen

Tapping the recipe for a dish you haven’t made yet will show the amount of each ingredient and the total number of ingredients required for that dish.

Additionally, a filter function will become available, allowing you to sort dishes using filters such as “No. of ingredients,” making it easier to find the dish you want to make.

Some text adjusted or unified

Other small bug fixes and adjustments

Event: Good Sleep Day #40

Outline

Rest your very best on the night of the full moon!

This event is held once a month for a total of three days—on the day of the full moon and the days before and after it—and provides a boost to Drowsy Power!

Let’s try to get lots of good sleep during this time and research loads of Pokémon sleep styles!

The event also includes bonus sleep points and bonuses to Pokémon’s Sleep EXP gains.

Additionally, from this Good Sleep Day onward, you’ll be able to encounter Mew as a special appearance!

We hope you’re looking forward to this!

Event Period:

• Oct. 25 (Sun) at 4:00 a.m. to Oct. 28 (Wed) at 3:59 a.m.

Note: The day of the full moon is Oct. 26 (Mon) .

Event Areas:

• All areas

Bonuses

The following effects will trigger in the applicable areas during this event.

— All Days —

• Mythical Pokémon will have a special appearance rate .

• Pokémon sleep styles you haven’t discovered yet are more likely to appear during sleep research.

• Pokémon with a special appearance rate won’t get full easily during the first snack time of the day.

• Every time you encounter a Pokémon with a special appearance rate during your New Moon Day sleep research, its friendship points will increase by 3 .

— Day 2 (Night of the Full Moon) —

• Drowsy Power ×4

• Helper Pokémon Sleep EXP ×3

• Bonus sleep points +1,000

— Day 1 and Day 3 —

• Drowsy Power ×1.5

• Helper Pokémon Sleep EXP ×2

• Bonus sleep points +500

Greater Appearance Rates

The following Pokémon can appear during this event!

— All Days —

Special Appearance Rate

• Mew

— Day 2 (Night of the Full Moon) —

Much Greater Appearance Rate

• Clefairy, Clefable, and Cleffa

— Day 1 and Day 3 —

Greater Appearance Rate

• Clefairy, Clefable, and Cleffa

Note: These Pokémon will appear in all applicable event areas.

Details

Multipliers for Drowsy Power

The multipliers for Drowsy Power on the night of a full moon during Good Sleep Day depend on the day of the week .

The planned multipliers are as follows.

■ Drowsy Power Multipliers on the Night of a Full Moon

Monday: ×4

Tuesday: ×3

Wednesday: ×2.5

Other days: ×2

Notes: Drowsy Power on the days before and after a full moon will always be multiplied by 1.5 regardless of the day of the week.

The above multipliers, which are dependent on the day of the week, are subject to change.

Special Appearance Rates

A special appearance rate is a bonus that gives you an opportunity to encounter Pokémon you normally wouldn’t meet.

During the Good Sleep Day event, you’ll be able to encounter Pokémon with special appearance rates in all areas, regardless of your sleep type.

Only one Pokémon with a special appearance rate can appear during the first sleep research of the day, and none will appear during the second sleep research of the day.

Additionally, each time you don’t encounter a Pokémon with a special appearance rate during sleep research, your chances of encountering a Pokémon with a special appearance rate during Good Sleep Day sleep research will increase a little.

Your increased chances of encountering Mew will carry over from previous New Moon Day events.

If you encounter a Pokémon with a special appearance rate, the number of Pokémon you encounter during that sleep research will increase by one.

Up to a maximum of 11 Pokémon can be encountered if you also use Pokémon incense or Good Camp Tickets.

Notes

• Important: Each day of the event rolls over at 4:00 a.m.

• Important: After the event ends, you’ll no longer be able to encounter Pokémon with special appearance rates in any area.

• Event bonuses apply only to sleep data tracked during the event.

• If you wait to report sleep data tracked before the event began and select “Review Later” during the event, event bonuses will not be applied.

• If you wait to report sleep data tracked during the event and select “Review Later” after the event has ended, event bonuses will be applied.

• You can only receive bonus sleep points once per day. You will not receive bonus sleep points for the second sleep session of the day.

• Event bonuses do not apply to sleep tracking during the tutorial.

• The effects of incense stack with Good Sleep Day effects. If you use Growth Incense on the night of the full moon, EXP gains will be multiplied by 6 (×3 from the full moon bonus and ×2 from the Growth Incense bonus).

• If overlapping events trigger more than one of the same type of bonus, the larger bonus will be applied.

• Normally, if you conduct sleep research twice in one day and research at least 11 Pokémon in a single day, the research rewards for the eleventh and any subsequent Pokémon will be less. However, if you encounter a Pokémon with a special appearance rate, the research rewards will be less for the twelfth and any subsequent Pokémon.

期間限定「迷你糖果增強」

相較於一般的「糖果增強」，「迷你糖果增強」消耗的夢之碎片較少量，是《Pokémon Sleep》的新手研究者也能輕鬆利用的期間限定功能。

使用「迷你糖果增強」後， 幫手寶可夢在使用糖果時可獲得的EXP 會變成 2倍 ，但使用1個糖果所需的 夢之碎片消耗量會是平時的 4倍 。 每天 最多可使用 50個糖果 。

此功能可透過點擊「等級提升」畫面右上角的按鈕來自由切換ON/OFF。想提升幫手寶可夢的等級時，就試著使用「 迷你糖果增強 」吧！

※此功能在企畫期間的預設為ON。

注意事項

・【重要】活動、企畫舉辦日期的切換時間為每日4:00。

・獎勵僅適用於活動／企畫期間內開始測量的睡眠資料。

・若將「活動／企畫開始前測量的睡眠資料」留到活動／企畫期間內進行「稍後再報告」，則不適用獎勵。

・若將「活動／企畫期間內測量的睡眠資料」留到活動／企畫結束後進行「稍後再報告」，則會適用獎勵。

・獎勵不適用於新手教學中的睡眠測量。

・相同的獎勵在不同的活動、企畫中同時登場時，僅適用倍率最大的獎勵。

・企畫結束後，將無法使用期間限定「迷你糖果增強」。此外，今後在其他活動、企畫開放「迷你糖果增強」時，EXP獲得量或夢之碎片消耗量的倍率，以及每日可使用的糖果數量等可能會有所變更。
